cards.answer: Corki is a marksman/mage who combines basic attacks with explosive missiles. His kit rewards AD, with physical damage, magic damage and bonus true damage.
cards.counterplay: Dodge his missiles, move out of his frontal spray and leave his fire trail.

cards.answer: Phosphorus Bomb explodes at a target location, dealing magic damage in an area. It grants sight of the impact area and temporarily reveals enemy champions hit.
cards.counterplay: Move away from the targeted area; account for the reveal when retreating.

cards.answer: Valkyrie dashes Corki to a target location, leaving a fire trail that repeatedly deals magic damage to enemies within it.
cards.counterplay: Leave the fire trail and look for pressure after he uses the dash.

cards.answer: Gatling Gun repeatedly deals physical damage in a cone toward Corki's facing direction. Hits stack reductions to armor and magic resistance, refreshing their duration.
cards.counterplay: Move out of his frontal spray and avoid prolonged trades while your resistances are reduced.

cards.answer: Missile Barrage fires a missile that explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing physical damage in an area. Corki stores missiles over time; every third missile is a Big One with greater range, damage and explosion radius. Basic attacks against champions shorten missile recharge.
cards.counterplay: Dodge the missiles, spread away from their impact points and respect the Big One's wider explosion.
